Who it is for

Non-science students who lose marks in the science portion of the GK paper.

Buy it if

You need the science syllabus compressed into facts you can revise in a day.

Avoid it if

You have a science background and already score well here.

How to use it

Use it purely for revision: one pass before the exam, marking only what you did not know.

Pros and cons

Pros

  • Written as short facts rather than textbook prose
  • Fits into a single revision pass

Cons

  • Recall, not explanation - little worked reasoning
  • Few diagrams beyond the basics

Topics covered

  • Physics
  • Chemistry
  • Biology
